items.title: Vendor onboarding

items.title: Commissions & payouts
items.description: Automated commission rules and clean payout reporting.

items.title: Admin control
items.description: Approvals, moderation, and full oversight from one dashboard.

items.title: You own everything
items.description: The store/accounts, code, data, and documentation stay with you — no lock-in.

faqs.question: Can vendors manage their own products?
faqs.answer: Yes — each vendor gets a dashboard to manage products, orders, and earnings, while you keep approval and oversight from the admin.

faqs.question: How are commissions and payouts handled?
faqs.answer: You set commission rules per vendor or category; the platform tracks earnings and reports payouts automatically.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
